translationRepairs: (The Old History of the Tang states he was a man of Xing Prefecture; the Comprehensive Mirror states he was a man of Qian Prefecture.)〉
(Ouyang Xiu's history states he was a man of Xing Prefecture; the Comprehensive Mirror states he was a man of Qian Prefecture.)〉
s0003 cites 《歐陽史》, Ouyang Xiu's history (Xin Wudai Shi), not the Old Tang History; the proposed literal matches the source label already used in the idiomatic.

The Old History of the Tang states: In the first year of Tianfu the Liang sent Shi Shuzong to attack Jin, coming out through Tianjing Pass; Qian opened the gates and surrendered, guiding the Liang army to attack Taiyuan, but they did not take it;

Ouyang Xiu's history states: In the first year of Tianfu the Liang sent Shi Shuzong to attack Jin, coming out through Tianjing Pass; Qian opened the gates and surrendered, guiding the Liang army to attack Taiyuan, but they did not take it;
s0055 again opens with 《歐陽史》云; rendering that as the Old History of the Tang invents the wrong work, and Ouyang Xiu's history restores the citation.

Wenli exploited their disaffection and secretly incited them: "The prince has ordered me to slaughter you all. I remember how for more than ten years you bore arms for me, for family and state alike; if I obey and kill you, I betray you;

Wenli exploited their disaffection and secretly incited them: "The lord has ordered me to bury you all alive. I remember how for more than ten years you bore arms and followed me, for family and state; if I do not kill you at once, I offend the lord;
s0080 has 我若不即殺爾，則得罪於令公 (if I do not kill you at once, I offend the lord); the prior idiomatic reverses the conditional, and 盡坑爾曹 / 荷戈隨我 support bury-alive and followed-me.
Thereafter Zhang pleaded that the land was narrow and the people poor, and only ten thousand tribute was permitted.
Thereafter Zhang pleaded that the land was narrow and the people poor, and only one hundred thousand tribute was permitted.
s0124 reads 許貢十萬而已; 十萬 is one hundred thousand, matching the idiomatic and contrasting the prior demand of 五十萬.
